title: The Lighter Brief
overview: A cozy Thanksgiving edition: a Charlotte nonprofit served 500+ holiday meals, Feid and Snoop Dogg dropped a gratitude song, and a reggae singer is making a whole album for her late dog. We also have some practical local notes, including a soggy-then-chilly Carolinas forecast and a boil water advisory in Marshville, plus a few updates from Jamaica and a city tug-of-war over the Essence Festival.

stories.headline: Charlotte Rescue Mission serves 500+ Thanksgiving meals
stories.summary: Volunteers at the Charlotte Rescue Mission spent Thanksgiving cooking and hand-serving free breakfast and lunch to anyone who needed it. The day began with a prayer and breakfast, and there were movies and table games too. Organizers said the goal was to make the day feel like family for everyone who came through the door.
key_facts: More than 500 free meals were served on Thanksgiving
The team started cooking 60 turkeys two weeks ahead
Kitchen manager and chef Brandy Legree was back at work at 2 a.m.
The nonprofit also runs addiction recovery programs and welcomes volunteers year-round
stories.why: As former program participant Roscoe Burris put it, "they gave me my life back." That is a lovely reminder of what this kind of work can mean.

stories.headline: Carolinas weather: rain clears, then a chilly, breezy Friday
stories.summary: A storm brought one to two inches of rain and gusty winds to the Carolinas around Thanksgiving, but showers were expected to ease by Thursday afternoon. Winds pick back up overnight, bringing a cold Friday and possible light snow in the mountains. The weekend looks mostly dry until rain returns late Sunday.
key_facts: Wind gusts of 30 to 40 mph are expected overnight into Friday
Friday highs will be in the upper 40s to low 50s, about 10 degrees below average
A few inches of snow are possible above 3,500 feet
Rain is expected late Sunday, which could slow post-holiday travel
stories.why: If you're driving home Sunday, try to leave earlier in the day.

links.title: Rain eases in Charlotte Thanksgiving afternoon, but gusty winds and mountain snow return
Rain clears into Turkey Day afternoon but a colder wind blows behind it

stories.headline: Marshville under a boil water advisory after main break
stories.summary: A water main break on Water Plant Road Wednesday afternoon left many Marshville, N.C., residents with little or no water on Thanksgiving. Crews worked overnight, but rain slowed repairs. As service returns, the town has issued a boil water advisory until further notice and apologized for the disruption to holiday plans.
key_facts: The break happened around 4 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25
The boil water advisory was issued around noon Thursday
Use bottled water or water brought to a rolling boil for at least one minute for drinking, cooking and brushing teeth
The cause of the break is not yet clear
stories.why: If you're in Marshville, keep boiling your water until the town says the advisory is lifted.

stories.headline: Jamaica's utility regulator and FLOW agree on complaint timelines
stories.summary: Jamaica's Office of Utilities Regulation (OUR) and FLOW signed an agreement that sets timelines for acknowledging, responding to and investigating customer complaints. The regulator wants to speed up how quickly complaints get resolved.
key_facts: The agreement was signed November 24, 2026
It is the OUR's second such agreement, after one with Digicel on March 4, 2026
stories.why: FLOW customers could see faster, clearer handling when something goes wrong with their service.

links.title: OUR, FLOW sign service level agreement for customer complaints

stories.headline: Reggae singer Sophia Dias is making an album for her late dog
stories.summary: US-based reggae artist Sophia Dias will record her third album at Jamaica's famed Tuff Gong Studio starting in February, with every song dedicated to her Bernese Mountain Dog, Mr Santos. She shared sweet memories, like bringing a blanket to restaurant patios so they could eat together, where waiters often brought him vanilla ice cream, his favorite. Mr Santos died three years ago, and he was best friends with her three cats.
key_facts: Veteran producer Clive Hunt is producing the seven-track album
Recording begins in February at Tuff Gong Studio
Mr Santos lived to 11, about a year beyond the breed's typical life expectancy
stories.why: Anyone who has loved a pet will understand wanting to write a whole album about them.

links.title: Reggae singer Sophia Dias to record album in tribute to her deceased dog

stories.headline: Falmouth mayor condemns vandalism at storm-damaged buildings
stories.summary: Trelawny's mayor, C Junior Gager, said a string of break-ins and thefts at buildings damaged by Hurricane Melissa is undermining recovery efforts. A suspect caught on security cameras has been handed over to police.
key_facts: Supplies meant for residents of the Trelawny Adult Residential Care Facility were stolen
The theft was discovered hours after PM Andrew Holness opened the first phase of the facility's new home
Doors were removed from the damaged Icy Allen building
stories.why: It shows the bumps in the road as communities rebuild after the hurricane.

links.title: Gager condemns vandalism of Melissa-damaged structures

stories.headline: War of words between Jamaican politicians
stories.summary: JLP Senator Abka Fitz-Henley criticized PNP caretaker Paul Buchanan for calling House Speaker Juliet Holness "this girl" at a protest. Fitz-Henley declined to respond to being called a "likkle fool" himself. He also disputed Buchanan's claim that trillions of dollars are unaccounted for.
key_facts: Buchanan made the remarks at a PNP protest on Tuesday
Fitz-Henley said the Auditor General's comments concerned delays in tabling financial statements dating from 2013, not missing money
disputed: Buchanan says trillions of dollars are unaccounted for; Fitz-Henley calls that false and points to a fact-checking portal that called the wording misleading
stories.why: It's a glimpse of the current tone in Jamaican politics and an ongoing argument over public finances.

links.title: Fitz-Henley condemns Buchanan for referring to House Speaker as ‘this girl’

stories.headline: Feid and Snoop Dogg release a Thanksgiving song, 'Gracias x Todo'
stories.summary: Colombian star Feid and Snoop Dogg released "Gracias x Todo," a song about gratitude and getting through life's ups and downs. The music video honors Feid's family and features a children's choir. Feid first previewed the song at the Latin Grammys, where Snoop made a surprise appearance.
key_facts: Released Thursday, Nov. 26
Feid won best reggaeton performance at the Latin Grammys for "Verano Rosa" with Karol G
He is set to appear in the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
His North American arena tour kicks off Feb. 5 in Orlando
stories.why: It's a feel-good soundtrack for a holiday about being thankful.

links.title: Feid and Snoop Dogg Drop Thanksgiving Collaboration ‘Gracias x Todo’
